verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so loading GGUF-packaged models is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions the GGUF format or loading user-supplied quantized model files. The only nearby item is a community note about a planned llama.cpp fallback on M1/M2, which never names GGUF and does not show the product loading such files.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
